name: oikos-devops
description: Infraestrutura de observabilidade e testes de carga para a Oikos API

scripts.test:k6: dotenv -e load-tests/.env.k6 -- k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw load-tests/suite.ts
scripts.test:load: dotenv -e load-tests/.env.k6 -- k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw --tag testid=load load-tests/load.ts
scripts.test:stress: dotenv -e load-tests/.env.k6 -- k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw --tag testid=stress load-tests/stress.ts
scripts.test:spike: dotenv -e load-tests/.env.k6 -- k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw --tag testid=spike load-tests/spike.ts
scripts.test:soak: dotenv -e load-tests/.env.k6 -- k6 run -o experimental-prometheus-rw --tag testid=soak load-tests/soak.ts
